name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY)
notes: Secondary sources report renewal rules consistently, but fresh track rules conflict (percentile vs percentage). Official source verification required before live deployment.

criteria.label: Certified Attendance >= 75%
criteria.verification: Certified by Head of Institute at term completion
criteria.notes: Midterm attendance provides trajectory indication; formal eligibility uses certified year-end attendance.

criteria.label: Previous Year Marks >= 50%
criteria.verification: Official marksheet percentage entry (never derived from SGPA)
criteria.notes: Student must enter attested marksheet percentage.

criteria.label: Annual Family Income <= 6,00,000 INR
criteria.notes: Requires valid income certificate as self-attested.

criteria.label: Gujarat Domicile
criteria.verification: Domicile certificate / Aadhaar / School leaving certificate

criteria.label: Currently an Approved Recipient (Renewal Track)
criteria.verification: Prior sanction order / student portal record
criteria.notes: Renewal requires proof of award in preceding year.

criteria.label: Fresh Track Entrance Criteria (Conflicting Sources)
criteria.verification: Unverified - sources conflict between 80 percentile vs 80% board marks
criteria.notes: Fresh applicant track evaluation is withheld until confirmed against official portal.
